hook: BasicClips: a link library for iPhone, iPad and Mac
hookText: BasicClips: a link library for iPhone, iPad and Mac

beats.say: Capture works from the share sheet, by pasting a URL, or by dragging in links, images, PDFs and files, and Shortcuts actions plus Spotlight indexing are built in.
On supported devices it can make a short on-device Apple Intelligence summary of a saved article.
A whimsical new app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac to save, collect, and organize all the interesting things you come across online, all in one place!
